title.en: Sectors of the economy and the circular flow

heading.en: Where does your rupee go next?

hook.en: You pay ₹20 for a plate of idli. The hotel uses it to pay the cook, who uses it to buy vegetables, and the vegetable seller pays her rent. Money keeps moving in a circle. Who are the players in this circle?
hook.kn: ನೀವು ಇಡ್ಲಿಗೆ ₹20 ಕೊಡುತ್ತೀರಿ. ಹೋಟೆಲ್ ಅದರಿಂದ ಅಡುಗೆಯವನಿಗೆ ಸಂಬಳ ಕೊಡುತ್ತದೆ, ಅವನು ತರಕಾರಿ ಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆ, ತರಕಾರಿ ಮಾರುವವಳು ಬಾಡಿಗೆ ಕಟ್ಟುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಹಣ ವೃತ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ ಸುತ್ತುತ್ತಲೇ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ವೃತ್ತದಲ್ಲಿರುವವರು ಯಾರು?

say.en: You pay 20 rupees for a plate of idli. The hotel uses it to pay the cook, who uses it to buy vegetables, and the vegetable seller pays her rent. Money keeps moving in a circle. Who are the players in this circle? In this lesson: Name the four sectors of a macroeconomy.
Describe the circular flow between households and firms.
Explain leakages and injections.

body.en: Households own the factors of production and consume goods and services. Firms hire factors and produce goods and services. The government collects taxes, spends on public services and makes laws. The external sector, or rest of the world, buys our exports, sells us imports and sends or receives capital.
body.kn: ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳು ಉತ್ಪಾದನಾಂಗಗಳ ಒಡೆಯರು ಮತ್ತು ಉಪಭೋಗಿಗಳು. ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳು ಉತ್ಪಾದನಾಂಗಗಳನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ ಸರಕು-ಸೇವೆ ಉತ್ಪಾದಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಸರ್ಕಾರ ತೆರಿಗೆ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿ ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಸೇವೆಗಳಿಗೆ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಬಾಹ್ಯ ವಲಯ ನಮ್ಮ ರಫ್ತು ಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ, ಆಮದು ಮಾರುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: The circular flow of income

say.en: Households own the factors of production. Firms hire them and produce goods.
Factor services go from households to firms; wages, rent, interest and profit come back.
Households spend their income on the goods firms make, so money returns to firms.
Saving leaks out of the flow; investment is injected back. Income stays steady when they are equal.
On the board: The circular flow of income.

caption.en: Yellow dots are money. Firms pay factor incomes to households (bottom); households spend on firms' goods (top). Saving leaks out to the financial market and investment flows back in. Play: income settles where investment equals saving, Y = I ÷ s.
caption.kn: ಹಳದಿ ಚುಕ್ಕೆಗಳು ಹಣ. ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳು ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳಿಗೆ ಆದಾಯ ಪಾವತಿಸುತ್ತವೆ (ಕೆಳಗೆ); ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳು ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳ ಸರಕುಗಳಿಗೆ ಖರ್ಚು ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ (ಮೇಲೆ). ಉಳಿತಾಯ ಸೋರಿಕೆ, ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ಸೇರ್ಪಡೆ. ಹೂಡಿಕೆ = ಉಳಿತಾಯ ಆದಾಗ ಆದಾಯ ಸ್ಥಿರ.

body.en: In a two-sector economy, households supply factor services to firms and receive wages, rent, interest and profit. They spend this *income* on goods and services produced by firms, and the money returns to firms. Saving is a leakage from this flow; investment is an injection back into it. Income stays at the same level when planned injections equal leakages.
body.kn: ಎರಡು ವಲಯದ ಆರ್ಥಿಕತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳು ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಉತ್ಪಾದನಾಂಗ ಸೇವೆ ನೀಡಿ ಕೂಲಿ, ಗೇಣಿ, ಬಡ್ಡಿ, ಲಾಭ ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತವೆ. ಈ ಆದಾಯವನ್ನು ಸರಕು-ಸೇವೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ; ಹಣ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಮರಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಉಳಿತಾಯ ಸೋರಿಕೆ, ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ಸೇರ್ಪಡೆ.

problem.en: In a two-sector economy, firms pay ₹500 crore as wages, ₹200 crore as rent, ₹100 crore as interest and ₹200 crore as profit. Households spend all their income. Find the factor income of households and the consumption expenditure on firms' output.

steps.en: With no saving, households spend all of it: consumption = ₹1,000 crore.
So the money flow back to firms equals the value of their output: ₹1,000 crore.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. In a two-sector economy, firms pay ₹500 crore as wages, ₹200 crore as rent, ₹100 crore as interest and ₹200 crore as profit. Households spend all their income. Find the factor income of households and the consumption expenditure on firms' output.

say.en: Let us work through this together. In a two-sector economy, firms pay 500 rupees crore as wages, 200 rupees crore as rent, 100 rupees crore as interest and 200 rupees crore as profit. Households spend all their income. Find the factor income of households and the consumption expenditure on firms' output.
Factor income equals 500 plus 200 plus 100 plus 200 equals 1,000 rupees crore.
With no saving, households spend all of it: consumption equals 1,000 rupees crore.
So the money flow back to firms equals the value of their output: 1,000 rupees crore.
So the answer is Factor income equals consumption expenditure equals 1,000 rupees crore.

homework.en: Draw the circular flow of income in a two-sector economy and label the real and money flows.

narration.en: Recap. A macroeconomy has households, firms, the government and the external sector. Factor services and goods flow one way; money flows the other way. Saving is a leakage; investment is an injection. Income stays constant when injections equal leakages.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಸ್ಥೂಲ ಆರ್ಥಿಕತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಟುಂಬ, ಸಂಸ್ಥೆ, ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಬಾಹ್ಯ ವಲಯಗಳಿವೆ. ಉತ್ಪಾದನಾಂಗ ಸೇವೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸರಕುಗಳು ಒಂದು ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ, ಹಣ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹರಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಉಳಿತಾಯ ಸೋರಿಕೆ; ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ಸೇರ್ಪಡೆ. ಸೇರ್ಪಡೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸೋರಿಕೆ ಸಮವಾದಾಗ ಆದಾಯ ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Let us recall the key ideas. A macroeconomy has households, firms, the government and the external sector.
say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. ಸ್ಥೂಲ ಆರ್ಥಿಕತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಟುಂಬ, ಸಂಸ್ಥೆ, ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಬಾಹ್ಯ ವಲಯಗಳಿವೆ.

say.en: Factor services and goods flow one way; money flows the other way.
say.kn: ಉತ್ಪಾದನಾಂಗ ಸೇವೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸರಕುಗಳು ಒಂದು ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ, ಹಣ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹರಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Saving is a leakage; investment is an injection.
Income stays constant when injections equal leakages.
say.kn: ಸೇರ್ಪಡೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸೋರಿಕೆ ಸಮವಾದಾಗ ಆದಾಯ ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ.
